title: Шоурил под бит
about: 15 секунд кинетики: слова, фигуры и склейки строго на долю.
prompt: Create a 15-second motion design showreel at 120 BPM. Every cut, scale pop and colour flip lands on a beat (one beat = 0.5 s). Act 1 (0–5 s): the words [WORD 1], [WORD 2], [WORD 3] slam in one per beat in heavy condensed type. Act 2 (5–11 s): circles, bars and triangles morph into each other with match cuts. Act 3 (11–15 s): everything collapses into [NAME / LOGO TEXT] on a solid [ACCENT COLOUR] background. Palette: black, off-white, [ACCENT COLOUR]. No easing longer than 0.4 s, no idle frames.

title: Швейцарский стиль
about: Строгая сетка, красный акцент, гротеск. Для дизайнеров.
prompt: Make a 20-second Swiss International Style motion piece. A visible 12-column grid draws itself first. Then [HEADLINE] is set in a neo-grotesk, flush left, and every element snaps to the grid: numbers, rules, a single red square. Motion is only translate and mask reveals, linear or ease-out, no bounce. End frame: [NAME], [ROLE], [YEAR] in a tidy information block. Background off-white #F2F0EB, text black, accent #E2231A.

title: Громкий хром
about: Хромовые буквы, чёрный фон, жёсткие склейки. Агрессивно и дорого.
prompt: A 12-second vertical showreel of loud kinetic typography. Huge chrome-gradient letters on pure black spell [WORD 1] / [WORD 2] / [WORD 3], each word filling the frame. Hard cuts every 0.5 s, occasional 2-frame white flash, letters stretch and skew on entry. Add a subtle film grain and a reflective sheen that sweeps across the letters. Finish on [CALL TO ACTION] in small white caps.

title: 12 принципов анимации
about: Сжатие, растяжение, упреждение, оверлап на простых фигурах.
prompt: Create a 20-second reel that demonstrates animation principles on simple shapes: squash and stretch (a bouncing ball), anticipation (a square that winds up before jumping), follow-through (a pendulum with a trailing tail), ease in / ease out (two dots racing, one linear, one eased), overshoot (a card scaling to 110 % then settling). Each principle gets 4 seconds and a small label in the corner. Flat pastel palette, white background.

title: Одно слово — десять стилей
about: Слово меняет шрифт и стиль каждые полсекунды.
prompt: A 10-second vertical clip where the single word [WORD] stays centred while its style changes every 0.5 s: serif, pixel, neon, handwritten, 3D extrude, glitch, outlined, stencil, bubble, chrome. Background colour changes with each style. Last 2 seconds the word settles in [FINAL STYLE] with a soft glow and the caption [CAPTION] fades in below.

title: Шрифт, форма, пространство
about: Три акта: от плоского текста к 3D-пространству.
prompt: A 15-second showreel in three acts. TYPE (0–5 s): the letters of [WORD] arrange and rearrange in flat 2D. FORM (5–10 s): the letters break into geometric primitives that rotate in pseudo-3D. SPACE (10–15 s): the camera pulls back through a field of those shapes floating in depth with perspective and fog, revealing [NAME] at the centre. Monochrome with one accent colour [ACCENT].

title: Резюме-ролик
about: Видео-визитка: имя, роль, навыки, контакты.
prompt: Create a 20-second motion self-introduction. 0–4 s: "Hi, I'm [NAME]" types itself on with a blinking cursor. 4–9 s: role "[ROLE]" and three skill chips [SKILL 1], [SKILL 2], [SKILL 3] pop in with overshoot. 9–15 s: three project cards [PROJECT 1/2/3] slide in from the right with tiny looping previews (abstract shapes are fine). 15–20 s: a contact card with [EMAIL / LINK] and a friendly wave emoji. Clean, light theme, rounded corners.

title: Нарочито ужасный шоурил
about: Смешная пародия: WordArt, звёздные вайпы, Comic Sans.
prompt: Make a deliberately terrible 15-second showreel for comedy. Use every cliché: WordArt rainbow text saying [TEXT], star wipes, spinning 3D cube transitions, lens flares, Comic Sans subtitles, clip-art arrows, a drop shadow on everything. Timing is slightly off the beat on purpose. End with "Thank you for watching!!!" bouncing in. It should look like 2003 PowerPoint, but be readable and funny.

title: Одна фигура — весь интерфейс
about: Одна форма морфит в кнопку, лоадер, плеер, график. Ведёт курсор.
prompt: A 20-second black-and-white product film for [PRODUCT]. A single rounded rectangle morphs continuously through UI states driven by a cursor: button → loading spinner → toggle → slider → music player → bar chart → notification. Each state lasts ~2.5 s and the cursor clicks to trigger the next. Spring physics on every morph. Final state: the shape becomes the [PRODUCT] logo with the tagline "[TAGLINE]".

title: Запуск одним дублем
about: Без склеек: экраны, фото и текст перетекают друг в друга.
prompt: Create a 30-second launch film for [PRODUCT] in one continuous camera move, no cuts. Start on a close-up of [KEY OBJECT/SCREEN], pull back to reveal the app UI, scroll through [FEATURE 1], [FEATURE 2], [FEATURE 3] as the camera glides; text callouts appear attached to the UI. Warm off-white canvas, soft shadows, one accent colour [ACCENT]. End on the logo and "[CTA]".

title: Ввёл запрос — получил результат
about: Пользователь печатает, интерфейс сам собирает ответ.
prompt: A 12-second square product sting for [PRODUCT]. A search/prompt box types "[USER QUERY]" character by character. On Enter, the result page builds itself: header, then [RESULT CARD 1], [RESULT CARD 2], [RESULT CARD 3] stack in with a 60 ms stagger. Two feature badges "[FEATURE A]" and "[FEATURE B]" slide in. Last frame: logo + URL. Light UI, crisp shadows.

title: Тизер новой фичи
about: Интрига: размытый экран, обратный отсчёт, раскрытие.
prompt: A 15-second vertical teaser for a new [PRODUCT] feature. 0–5 s: blurred, cropped glimpses of the new screen with the text "Something new is coming". 5–10 s: countdown 3-2-1 with each number punching in. 10–15 s: the blur clears revealing [FEATURE NAME] in action, with the date "[LAUNCH DATE]" below. Dark theme, accent glow [ACCENT].

title: Запуск в стиле твита
about: Ролик собран из карточек-постов и лайков.
prompt: Create a 20-second SaaS launch video that looks like a social feed. Post cards appear one after another: a founder post "We just launched [PRODUCT]", reply bubbles with reactions, a like counter rolling up to [NUMBER], a quote card with a customer saying "[QUOTE]". Cards slide and stack with springy motion. End: big "[PRODUCT] — [TAGLINE]" and a link.

title: Прогулка по приложению
about: Телефон в кадре, экраны листаются, подписи-выноски.
prompt: A 25-second vertical walkthrough of the [APP NAME] mobile app. A phone mockup sits centre; screens change with smooth swipes: onboarding → [SCREEN 1] → [SCREEN 2] → [SCREEN 3]. A finger-tap ripple shows each interaction. Short captions above the phone (max 5 words each) explain the benefit, not the feature. Final screen: App Store / Google Play badges and "[CTA]". Use the attached screenshots if provided.

title: Реферальная программа
about: Пригласи друга — получи бонус: две аватарки и монетки.
prompt: A 12-second square promo for a referral programme. Two friendly avatars sit left and right; a link icon flies from one to the other, then coins / gift boxes burst for both with the numbers "[REWARD YOU]" and "[REWARD FRIEND]". Big headline "Invite a friend, get [REWARD]". Bright, rounded, playful, brand colour [COLOUR].

title: Эмоциональное промо
about: Не про функции, а про чувство: история одного пользователя.
prompt: A 30-second emotional promo for [PRODUCT], told without showing the UI until the end. Minimal illustrated scenes of one person's day: [PROBLEM MOMENT] → frustration (muted colours) → discovering a small helper → [GOOD MOMENT] (colours warm up). One line of text per scene, max 6 words. Only in the last 5 seconds the app screen appears with the logo and "[TAGLINE]". Soft piano-friendly pacing.

title: Тарифы
about: Три тарифа появляются слева направо, выделяется лучший.
prompt: A 20-second animation of [PRODUCT] pricing. Three plan cards appear left to right: [PLAN 1, PRICE], [PLAN 2, PRICE], [PLAN 3, PRICE], each with three checkmark features that tick on. Then the middle card lifts, gets a glowing border and a "Most popular" badge; a toggle flips from monthly to annual and prices count down to show the [DISCOUNT] saving. End: "Start free" button pulse.

title: До и после
about: Разделённый экран: хаос без продукта vs порядок с ним.
prompt: A 15-second vertical before/after. A vertical divider splits the screen. Left "Before": a messy stack of [PAIN ITEMS] (tabs, notes, spreadsheets) jittering chaotically in grey. Right "After": the same items neatly organised inside [PRODUCT] in colour. The divider sweeps left until the "After" side fills the frame. Caption: "[BENEFIT IN 5 WORDS]". Logo at the end.

title: Понятие через метафору
about: «X — это как Y»: объект превращается в метафору и обратно.
prompt: Create a 30-second vertical explainer: "[CONCEPT] is like [METAPHOR]". Scene 1: a big question "What is [CONCEPT]?". Scene 2: the metaphor is drawn in simple flat shapes ([METAPHOR DETAILS]). Scene 3: each part of the metaphor morphs into the real component it represents, with a label. Scene 4: one-sentence summary. Friendly flat illustration, max 8 words on screen at a time.

title: Как это работает: 4 шага
about: Нумерованные шаги со стрелками и иконками.
prompt: A 30-second "how it works" explainer for [PROCESS]. Four numbered steps appear in sequence along a horizontal path: 1. [STEP 1], 2. [STEP 2], 3. [STEP 3], 4. [STEP 4]. Each step: an icon draws itself, a one-line label types in, an arrow animates to the next step. After step 4 the camera zooms out to show the whole flow at once. Clean, two-tone palette.

title: Алгоритм наглядно
about: Сортировка, поиск, рекурсия — шаг за шагом на блоках.
prompt: Visualise the [ALGORITHM] algorithm in 30 seconds. Use [N] coloured bars/blocks with their values on them. Animate every comparison (highlight two elements yellow), every swap (elements arc past each other), and mark finished elements green. Show a small step counter and a pseudocode panel on the right where the current line is highlighted in sync. End with the complexity "[O(...)]" and a one-line takeaway.

title: История на таймлайне
about: Горизонтальная лента лет, события выскакивают по очереди.
prompt: A 45-second animated history of [TOPIC]. A horizontal timeline scrolls from [START YEAR] to [END YEAR]. At each key date a marker drops and a card opens with the year, a 5-word event title and a simple icon: [EVENT 1], [EVENT 2], [EVENT 3], [EVENT 4], [EVENT 5]. The camera moves along the timeline; past events fade to grey. Final shot: the whole timeline visible and a closing line "[TAKEAWAY]".

title: Путешествие частицы
about: Следуем за фотоном/каплей/клеткой через весь процесс.
prompt: A 40-second science explainer following [OBJECT, e.g. a photon / a drop of water / a red blood cell] on its journey through [PROCESS]. Each stage is a scene with a small label and a fact: [STAGE 1], [STAGE 2], [STAGE 3], [STAGE 4]. Show a running counter of [TIME OR DISTANCE]. Glowing particle on a dark background with soft gradients, scientific but cinematic.

title: Математика на доске
about: Формулы пишутся «от руки», графики рисуются сами.
prompt: Make a 30-second whiteboard-style explanation of [MATH IDEA]. White background, dark marker strokes that draw on progressively like handwriting. Write the formula [FORMULA], then draw a graph/diagram that illustrates it, then highlight the key part in a second colour and show one worked example with numbers. Hand-drawn wobble on lines, no fonts that look typed.

title: Рецепт анимацией
about: Пустой стакан/тарелка наполняется по ингредиентам с граммовкой.
prompt: A 30-second recipe motion graphic for [DISH]. Start with an empty [GLASS/PLATE]. Each ingredient enters one by one with its measurement on screen: [INGREDIENT 1 — AMOUNT], [INGREDIENT 2 — AMOUNT], [INGREDIENT 3 — AMOUNT]… Liquids pour, solids drop with a little bounce, layers stack visibly. Then the action step ([STIR / BAKE / SHAKE]) with a timer. End on the finished dish and its name. Flat, appetising colours.

title: Что происходит за одну секунду
about: Счётчики событий мира за 1 секунду.
prompt: A 20-second vertical infographic: "What happens in one second on [EARTH / THE INTERNET / YOUR BODY]". A big 1-second clock ring sweeps slowly. Around it, counters appear one after another: [FACT 1 with number], [FACT 2], [FACT 3], [FACT 4], [FACT 5], each with a tiny icon and number rolling up. Dark background, neon accents. Note: use the numbers I give; if none are given, mark them as approximate.

title: Миф или факт
about: Карточка с мифом переворачивается — на обороте правда.
prompt: A 25-second vertical "Myth vs Fact" about [TOPIC]. Three rounds. Each round: a red card "MYTH: [MYTH]" appears, a stamp hits it with a cross, the card flips to a green "FACT: [FACT]" with a one-line reason. Score dots fill at the top. Bold, readable type for phone screens, max 10 words per card.

title: Онбординг для новых клиентов
about: Пошаговый тур по сервису с подсветкой элементов.
prompt: Create a 40-second onboarding walkthrough for new customers of [PRODUCT]. Use the attached screenshots. Step by step: [STEP 1], [STEP 2], [STEP 3], [STEP 4]. For each step dim the rest of the UI, spotlight the relevant element with a soft ring, show a cursor doing the action, and a caption under 8 words. A progress bar at the top shows 1/4 … 4/4. End: "You're all set" and where to get help.

title: Квартальный отчёт за 30 секунд
about: Итоги квартала для общей встречи: 3 цифры и вывод.
prompt: Turn this quarterly report into a 30-second explainer for our all-hands. Audience: the whole company, plays on a big screen. Use only the facts in the attached file / these numbers: [METRIC 1], [METRIC 2], [METRIC 3]. Structure: title card → each metric as a big number that counts up with a one-line context → one chart showing the trend → "What's next: [NEXT STEP]". Brand colours [COLOURS], no stock imagery.

title: Гонка столбцов
about: Столбцы обгоняют друг друга по годам.
prompt: Create a 30-second bar chart race of [WHAT IS COMPARED] from [START YEAR] to [END YEAR] using this data: [PASTE CSV OR TABLE]. Top [N] bars, sorted live, bars smoothly overtake each other, values tick at the end of each bar, a large year counter in the bottom right. Each entity has a fixed colour and a label. Hold the final year for 3 seconds.

title: Рубеж: миллион пользователей
about: Счётчик бежит до круглой цифры, конфетти.
prompt: A 15-second vertical celebration of [PRODUCT] reaching [MILESTONE NUMBER] [USERS/VISITORS/ORDERS]. A big odometer counter rolls from 0 to the number, accelerating; a line chart of growth draws behind it. When it hits the target: confetti burst, the number scales up, text "Thank you" and [SHORT MESSAGE]. Brand colour [COLOUR].

title: Оживший график для презентации
about: Один график из слайда, но с движением и акцентом.
prompt: Add motion to this board-deck chart: [DESCRIBE OR ATTACH CHART]. 12 seconds. Axes draw first, then the data series animate in left to right, then the key point [KEY POINT, e.g. Q3 jump] gets highlighted with a callout and a short label "[INSIGHT]". Everything else dims to 40 %. Keep corporate-clean styling, no 3D effects.

title: Сравнение двух вариантов
about: А против Б по пяти параметрам.
prompt: A 20-second vertical comparison: [OPTION A] vs [OPTION B]. Two columns with their names/logos at the top. Five rows appear one by one: [PARAMETER 1..5], each with values for A and B and a small bar showing which is better; the winner of each row glows. Final score at the bottom and a verdict line "[VERDICT]". Neutral, fair styling.

title: Распространение по карте
about: Точки и линии расползаются по карте мира/страны.
prompt: A 25-second map animation showing how [THING] spread across [WORLD / COUNTRY] from [START] to [END]. A minimalist flat map; dots appear at [LOCATIONS] in chronological order with connecting arcs; a date counter at the top; a small legend. Colour intensity grows with [VALUE]. End with a summary number "[TOTAL]".

title: Итоги года в стиле Wrapped
about: Личная статистика по слайдам: топы, минуты, сюрприз.
prompt: A 30-second vertical "Year Wrapped" for [PERSON/BRAND/CHANNEL]. 6 slides, ~5 s each, bold gradient backgrounds that change every slide: 1) "Your [YEAR]" intro, 2) total [MAIN NUMBER] counting up, 3) top 5 [ITEMS] list sliding in, 4) the fun fact "[FUN FACT]", 5) a personality label "You are a [LABEL]", 6) share card summary. Big playful type, sticker-like shapes.

title: Дашборд оживает
about: Пустой дашборд заполняется виджетами и цифрами.
prompt: A 20-second reveal of a [PRODUCT] analytics dashboard. Start with an empty grid; widgets fly into place one by one: KPI tiles with numbers counting up ([KPI 1], [KPI 2], [KPI 3]), a line chart drawing itself, a donut chart filling, a table with rows sliding in. Then a cursor hovers the line chart and a tooltip shows [INSIGHT]. Dark UI, one accent colour.

title: Логотип собирается медленно
about: Детали логотипа собираются из линий и точек.
prompt: An 8-second logo reveal for [BRAND]. Start with scattered points and thin lines on a dark background; they slowly drift, connect and assemble into the logo [DESCRIBE LOGO OR ATTACH SVG]. When complete, a soft light sweep passes across it and the name [BRAND] fades in below with letter spacing tightening. Calm, premium pacing.

title: Интро канала
about: 3 секунды: имя канала, фирменный цвет, звуковой акцент.
prompt: A 4-second YouTube channel intro for [CHANNEL NAME]. A shape in [BRAND COLOUR] bursts from the centre, wipes the frame, and the channel name snaps in with a bounce and a short shake on impact (the moment a sound hit would land at 1.2 s). Subtle particles linger. Energetic, readable on mobile.

title: Конечная заставка
about: Подпишись + две карточки следующих видео.
prompt: A 10-second YouTube end screen for [CHANNEL]. Leave two empty 16:9 slots on the right for video cards and a circle slot for the subscribe button (they will be added by YouTube). Left side: "Thanks for watching" and [CHANNEL HANDLE] animate in; background has a slow looping gradient and floating shapes in brand colours [COLOURS].

title: Плашка с именем (lower third)
about: Имя и должность спикера внизу кадра.
prompt: Design an animated lower third: a bar slides in from the left, then "[NAME]" and "[TITLE]" appear with a mask reveal; hold 4 s; exit to the left. Transparent background so it can overlay video. Brand colour [COLOUR], sans-serif type, works on light and dark footage.

title: Набор переходов
about: 5 переходов между сценами в фирменном стиле.
prompt: Create a pack of five 2-second brand transitions in [BRAND COLOURS]: 1) diagonal stripe wipe, 2) circle iris in/out, 3) liquid blob morph, 4) grid of squares flipping, 5) shape zoom-through. Each one fully covers the frame at its midpoint (so a cut can hide underneath). Play them in sequence with a label for each.

title: Глитч-логотип
about: Цифровые помехи, RGB-сдвиг, затем чистый логотип.
prompt: A 5-second glitch logo sting for [BRAND]. The logo appears corrupted: RGB channel split, horizontal slice offsets, scan lines and flickering blocks for 2 seconds, then snaps to a clean, stable logo with a short chromatic flash. Black background, logo in white with [ACCENT] highlights.

title: Бумажная аппликация
about: Логотип из слоёв бумаги с тенями.
prompt: A 6-second paper cut-out style logo reveal: layers of coloured paper slide in from different sides, each casting a soft drop shadow, and assemble into [LOGO DESCRIPTION]. Slight paper texture and a tiny wobble as each layer settles. Warm palette [COLOURS].

title: Юбилей бренда
about: Цифра юбилея, архив лет, праздничный финал.
prompt: A 15-second anniversary film for [BRAND]'s [N]th year. A year counter flips from [FOUNDING YEAR] to [CURRENT YEAR] while small milestone captions pass by ([MILESTONE 1], [MILESTONE 2], [MILESTONE 3]). The final number [N] builds out of the brand's shapes, then "[N] years of [WHAT]" and a thank-you line. Gold accents on [BRAND COLOUR].

title: Топ-5 с обратным отсчётом
about: 5 → 1, на первом месте сюрприз.
prompt: A 30-second vertical "Top 5 [TOPIC]" countdown. Hook (0–2 s): "Number 1 will surprise you". Then #5 to #1, ~5 s each: a big rank number slams in, the item name, one punchy fact, a simple icon or illustration. #1 gets a bigger reveal with a flash. Bold captions centred, safe from the top 15 % and bottom 20 % of the screen (UI zones).

title: А вы знали?
about: Один удивительный факт, разобранный за 15 секунд.
prompt: A 15-second vertical "Did you know?" clip about [FACT]. 0–2 s hook: the surprising statement in huge type. 2–11 s: three quick visual beats explaining why it's true. 11–15 s: "Follow for more [TOPIC]" with a small arrow. Big, high-contrast captions, one idea per screen.

title: POV-история текстом
about: «POV: ты …» и сценки из коротких реплик.
prompt: A 20-second vertical POV story made of on-screen text and simple illustrations. Opening caption "POV: you [SITUATION]". Then 5 beats, each a short line of dialogue or thought ([BEAT 1..5]) in chat-bubble or meme-caption style, with a quick zoom on the punchline. Ends on a relatable twist line "[TWIST]".

title: Переписка в мессенджере
about: История через чат: сообщения появляются с набором.
prompt: A 25-second vertical animated phone chat between [PERSON A] and [PERSON B]. Messages appear one by one with a typing indicator first; timing feels natural. Script: [PASTE DIALOGUE]. The last message is the punchline and gets a little shake + emoji reaction. Use a generic messenger look (not a real brand's UI).

title: Это или то
about: Два варианта, голосование, счётчик процентов.
prompt: A 20-second vertical "This or That" game with 4 rounds about [TOPIC]. Each round: the screen splits top/bottom with [OPTION A] and [OPTION B], a 3-second timer ring, then fake percentage bars fill to show "what most people chose". Bright contrasting colours for the two halves, big emoji.

title: Лайфхак за 3 шага
about: Проблема → 3 действия → результат.
prompt: A 20-second vertical life-hack clip: "How to [GOAL] in 3 steps". Hook shows the problem [PROBLEM]. Steps 1–3 each have a big number, an icon and a 6-word instruction. Final screen shows the result and "Save this for later". Clean, friendly, tons of whitespace.

title: Угадай за 3 секунды
about: Размытая картинка/силуэт проясняется по таймеру.
prompt: A 25-second vertical guessing quiz: "Guess the [CATEGORY] in 3 seconds". 5 rounds: a heavily blurred or silhouetted shape of [ITEM] appears, a 3-2-1 timer, then it un-blurs with the answer label. Score prompt "How many did you get?" at the end. Use simple illustrated shapes, not real photos or logos.

title: Цитата дня
about: Красивая цитата с медленным движением и фоном.
prompt: A 10-second vertical quote card: "[QUOTE]" — [AUTHOR]. Words fade in one by one in an elegant serif, the background is a slow-moving abstract gradient in [MOOD COLOURS]. The author name appears last in small caps. Calm pacing, perfect for a loop.

title: История в эмодзи
about: Сюжет фильма/события рассказан эмодзи.
prompt: A 20-second vertical clip telling the story of [MOVIE/EVENT/DAY] using only big emoji sequences, 2–3 emoji per beat, 6 beats, each with a short caption. Emoji bounce, rotate and interact (chase, collide, hug). Final card: "Guess the [MOVIE]?" or the answer. Pastel background that changes per beat.

title: Один день из жизни
about: Таймлайн дня: часы и сценки.
prompt: A 30-second vertical "A day in the life of a [ROLE]". A clock in the corner jumps through the day: [07:00 — ACTIVITY], [09:00 — ACTIVITY], [13:00 — ACTIVITY], [18:00 — ACTIVITY], [23:00 — ACTIVITY]. Each moment is a simple flat scene with a one-line caption. Colour temperature shifts from morning cool to evening warm.

title: Герой в кадре: наезд
about: Медленный наезд на героя, который оборачивается.
prompt: Slow dolly-in, eye level, 35mm lens. [CHARACTER: age, clothing, one distinctive detail] stands with their back to camera in [LOCATION], then slowly turns to face the lens. Golden hour backlight, rim light on hair, shallow depth of field, gentle haze. Cinematic colour grade, teal shadows, warm highlights. Sound: distant wind, a low swelling note.

title: Дрон над локацией
about: Открывающий общий план сверху.
prompt: Aerial drone shot, high altitude, slowly gliding forward and tilting down over [LANDSCAPE / CITY] at [TIME OF DAY]. [WEATHER: low fog / light rain / clear sky]. A single [OBJECT: car / boat / person] moves through the scene to give scale. Photorealistic, natural colours, 4K documentary look. Sound: ambient wind and faint [AMBIENT SOUND].

title: Облёт продукта
about: Камера кружит вокруг предмета на подиуме.
prompt: Smooth 180° orbit around [PRODUCT] standing on a [MATERIAL] pedestal in a minimal studio. Soft key light from the left, a moving light sweep reveals reflections on the surface. Dark gradient background, subtle floating dust particles. Product stays centred and sharp. Commercial, premium, 8K detail. Sound: soft whoosh and a low synth hit at the end.

title: Неоновая улица под дождём
about: Киберпанк-атмосфера, отражения в лужах.
prompt: Low-angle tracking shot following [CHARACTER] walking down a narrow neon-lit street at night in heavy rain. Reflections of pink and cyan signs in puddles, steam rising from vents, umbrellas passing by. Handheld feel, slight motion blur, anamorphic lens flares. Blade-Runner-like mood but original signage with no real brands. Sound: rain, distant traffic, muffled music.

title: Макро-деталь
about: Крупный план текстуры: капли, ткани, механизм.
prompt: Extreme macro shot, slow slide left. [SUBJECT: dew drops on a leaf / coffee crema / watch gears / fabric weave] fills the frame; tiny details are razor-sharp while the background melts into creamy bokeh. Soft natural light, high micro-contrast. Slow-motion feel. Sound: a quiet, close [SOUND: drip / tick / rustle].

title: Таймлапс изменения
about: День сменяется ночью, город загорается огнями.
prompt: Static wide shot, time-lapse of [PLACE] from [START: sunset] to [END: night]. Clouds streak across the sky, shadows sweep, lights switch on window by window, traffic becomes light trails. Photorealistic, locked-off camera, smooth exposure transition. Sound: an ambient track with rising tension.

title: Пролёт сквозь пространство
about: Камера влетает в окно и пролетает сквозь комнаты.
prompt: Continuous FPV-style camera move: start outside [BUILDING], fly through an open window, glide through [ROOM 1] and [ROOM 2] past people [ACTIVITY], and end on a close-up of [FINAL OBJECT]. No cuts, steady and smooth, slight speed ramps at doorways. Warm interior light. Sound: muffled room tones changing as the camera passes.

title: Силуэт на закате
about: Эпичный силуэт на фоне огромного неба.
prompt: Wide static shot, [CHARACTER] in silhouette standing on [CLIFF / ROOFTOP / DUNE] against a huge [SUNSET / STORM / AURORA] sky. Their coat moves in the wind; birds cross the frame. Epic scale, the character is small in the lower third. Rich gradient sky, film grain. Sound: wind and a deep orchestral swell.

title: Замедленный удар
about: Брызги, осколки, порошок в slow motion.
prompt: Ultra slow-motion, 1000 fps look. [OBJECT: a strawberry / paint balloon / glass of water] [ACTION: drops into milk / bursts / shatters] against a black background; droplets and fragments freeze mid-air in crisp detail. Hard side light, high contrast. Camera slowly pushes in. Sound: deep, stretched impact with a long tail.

title: Головокружение (dolly zoom)
about: Фон «растягивается» вокруг героя — момент осознания.
prompt: Dolly zoom (vertigo effect): the camera pulls back while zooming in, so [CHARACTER] stays the same size and the background of [LOCATION] stretches away. Their expression shifts to sudden realisation. Moody lighting, cinematic grade. Sound: a rising dissonant tone that cuts to silence.

title: Карточка героя
about: Опиши героя один раз — вставляй во все промпты.
prompt: CHARACTER: [NAME], a [AGE / SPECIES] with [BODY SHAPE], [HAIR / FUR], wearing [OUTFIT], always has [SIGNATURE ITEM]. Personality: [3 TRAITS]. Style: [3D clay / stylised 3D cartoon / flat 2D / anime / pixel art]. Colour palette: [3 COLOURS]. — Paste this exact line at the start of every image and video prompt for the series.

title: Пластилиновый маскот объясняет
about: Глиняный герой рассказывает о сложном на столе.
prompt: Stop-motion claymation style. [CHARACTER LINE]. The character stands on a wooden desk among oversized everyday objects and points at [PROP] while explaining [TOPIC] with lively hand gestures. Visible fingerprints in the clay, slightly choppy 12 fps motion, warm practical lighting. Medium shot. Dialogue: "[LINE]".

title: 3D-мультик: эмоция
about: Крупный план мультяшного героя с яркой эмоцией.
prompt: 3D animated feature style (stylised, not a specific studio). Close-up of [CHARACTER LINE] reacting to [EVENT]: eyes widen, ears/eyebrows rise, a slow smile spreads. Soft subsurface skin, big expressive eyes, warm bounce light, shallow depth of field. Sound: a small surprised gasp and a soft musical sting.

title: Аниме-экшен
about: Динамичный аниме-кадр со скоростными линиями.
prompt: Japanese anime style, hand-drawn look. [CHARACTER LINE] leaps from [PLACE] toward the camera, cape and hair whipping, speed lines and impact frames, a burst of [ELEMENT: wind / sparks / petals]. Dramatic low angle, sky full of clouds. Sound: whoosh, impact and a short battle shout.

title: Говорящий предмет
about: Оживший предмет (кружка, кот, растение) говорит в камеру.
prompt: A [OBJECT: coffee mug / houseplant / old phone] with a cute cartoon face comes to life on a kitchen counter and talks directly to camera: "[LINE]". Mouth moves in sync, eyes blink, it hops slightly on key words. Realistic kitchen background, soft daylight, playful tone. Voice: [VOICE: grumpy old man / cheerful kid / calm narrator].

title: Сказочная сцена
about: Иллюстрация-сказка, как из детской книги.
prompt: Storybook watercolour illustration style, gently animated. [CHARACTER LINE] walks through [MAGICAL PLACE: glowing mushroom forest / floating islands / snowy village] while [SMALL MAGIC: fireflies follow / leaves swirl / lanterns light up]. Slow parallax camera pan, soft paper texture, warm cosy palette. Narrator: "[STORY LINE]".

title: Мини-драма из 3 кадров
about: Завязка, поворот, развязка — 3 промпта подряд.
prompt:
SHOT 1 (8 s): [CHARACTER LINE] in [PLACE] does [NORMAL ACTION]; something small goes wrong: [INCITING MOMENT]. Medium shot.
SHOT 2 (8 s): close-up, they react; the tension rises: [COMPLICATION]. Handheld, faster.
SHOT 3 (8 s): wide shot, the unexpected twist [TWIST], everyone freezes, then laughs/sighs. Same lighting and wardrobe in all three shots.

title: Герой и напарник: диалог
about: Двое в кадре спорят/шутят.
prompt: Two-shot. [CHARACTER A LINE] and [CHARACTER B LINE] sit side by side on [PLACE]. A: "[LINE A]". B (deadpan): "[LINE B]". A reacts with a big comedic double-take. Stylised [STYLE], warm lighting, camera slowly pushes in on the punchline. Clear lip-sync, natural pauses.

title: Питомец со сверхспособностью
about: Кот/собака внезапно делает невозможное.
prompt: Realistic home video look, phone camera. A [PET: ginger cat / corgi] sits on the sofa, then casually [SUPERPOWER: levitates the remote / types on a laptop / opens the fridge with telekinesis] while the owner's hand freezes in frame. Natural living room light, slight handheld shake, comedic timing. Sound: TV in background, a stunned "…what?".

title: Селфи из прошлого
about: Персонаж эпохи снимает влог на «телефон».
prompt: Selfie-vlog style, front camera at arm's length. A [ERA] [ROLE: Roman legionary / Viking / 1920s pilot] (fictional, not a real person) talks to camera while walking through [PERIOD-ACCURATE PLACE]: "[LINE]". Authentic costume details, period background bustle, natural daylight, slight camera bob. Humorous modern phrasing.

title: UGC-отзыв
about: «Обычный человек» рассказывает о продукте на телефон.
prompt: UGC style, vertical phone footage, front camera. A friendly [AGE] [PERSON DESCRIPTION, fictional] sits in their [CAR / BEDROOM / KITCHEN] holding [PRODUCT] and says naturally: "Okay, I didn't expect this, but [PRODUCT] actually [BENEFIT]." Casual daylight, slight handheld shake, authentic, not over-produced. Burned-in captions.

title: Проблема → решение
about: Боль за 2 секунды, продукт решает, результат.
prompt: SHOT 1 (3 s): close-up of frustration: [PROBLEM, e.g. tangled cables / spilled coffee]. SHOT 2 (6 s): hands use [PRODUCT], the problem disappears smoothly. SHOT 3 (6 s): satisfied result shot, product hero on a clean surface, text "[BENEFIT]". Bright, crisp commercial lighting, upbeat.

title: Распаковка
about: Руки открывают коробку, детали крупно.
prompt: Top-down overhead shot of hands unboxing [PRODUCT] on a [SURFACE]. The lid lifts slowly, tissue paper unfolds, the product is revealed and lifted toward the camera; then a close-up of [KEY DETAIL]. Soft daylight, satisfying ASMR pacing. Sound: paper rustle, a gentle click.

title: Еда как в рекламе
about: Сырный тянущийся кадр, пар, капли.
prompt: Food commercial macro shot. [DISH] on a rustic plate; a fork lifts a piece and [HERO MOMENT: cheese stretches / sauce drips / steam rises] in slow motion. Warm backlight, glistening highlights, dark moody background, shallow depth of field. Sound: sizzle and a soft crunch.

title: Косметика: всплеск
about: Флакон, вода, лепестки — премиум-эстетика.
prompt: Luxury beauty commercial. A [PRODUCT: serum bottle / lipstick] falls in slow motion into clear water, creating a crown splash; [INGREDIENT: rose petals / citrus slices] swirl around it. Pastel [COLOUR] background, soft studio light, pristine reflections. Final 1 s: product upright, perfectly still.

title: Приложение в реальной жизни
about: Человек пользуется телефоном, интерфейс «вылетает» в мир.
prompt: A person in [PLACE] looks at their phone; floating holographic UI elements from [APP TYPE] emerge from the screen into the real room: [UI ELEMENTS: cards / maps / reminders]. They swipe one in the air with their finger. Natural light, realistic, subtle VFX glow. Upbeat modern feel.

title: Ролик для местного бизнеса
about: Кофейня/барбершоп/студия: атмосфера и люди.
prompt: Three-shot promo for a local [BUSINESS: coffee shop / barber / flower studio] called [NAME]. SHOT 1: exterior at morning light, door opens. SHOT 2: close-up of craft [ACTION: latte art / clipper fade / tying a bouquet]. SHOT 3: happy customer receives the result, smiles. Warm, authentic, handheld-cinematic. Text at the end: "[NAME] · [ADDRESS/HANDLE]".

title: Продукт-великан
about: Огромный продукт посреди города — сюрреалистичная реклама.
prompt: Surreal commercial: a giant [PRODUCT] the size of a building stands in the middle of [CITY SQUARE]; people walk around it and take photos; birds fly past; the camera cranes up to reveal its full size. Photorealistic, daylight, slight haze for scale. CGI-ad style (out-of-home campaign look).

title: Резка кинетического песка
about: Нож режет цветной песок, слои рассыпаются.
prompt: Close-up ASMR: a sharp knife slowly slices through a block of layered [COLOURS] kinetic sand; the slice crumbles in satisfying slow detail. Top-lit studio, soft shadows, clean white surface. Sound: crisp crunchy slicing, no music.

title: Бесшовный луп
about: Объект вращается/переливается и замыкает цикл.
prompt: Seamless loop: [OBJECT: an iridescent glass sphere / a woven knot / a stack of rings] rotates and morphs in a perfectly repeating cycle; the final frame is identical to the first. Pastel gradient background, soft studio light, ray-traced reflections. Calm, hypnotic.

title: Уютное окно и дождь
about: Lo-fi-атмосфера: чай, лампа, капли.
prompt: Static shot from inside a cosy [ROOM] at night: rain streams down a large window, city lights blur outside, a steaming cup of tea and an open book on the windowsill, a warm lamp glows, a cat sleeps nearby. Very slow subtle movement only (steam, rain, tail twitch). Lo-fi aesthetic, seamless loop. Sound: rain, soft crackle.

title: Миниатюрный мир
about: Тилт-шифт: город/кухня как игрушечные.
prompt: Tilt-shift miniature effect: a tiny [SCENE: bustling food market / train station / construction site] seen from above at an angle, little people and vehicles moving slightly fast. Strong blur top and bottom, saturated toy-like colours, bright sun. Sound: playful ambient bustle.

title: Заливка красками
about: Акриловые краски растекаются узорами.
prompt: Top-down macro of an acrylic paint pour: [COLOURS] paints flow and swirl over a canvas, forming cells and marbled patterns; a gentle tilt makes them spread to the edges. Glossy wet surface, bright even light. Sound: soft liquid trickles.

title: Готовка ASMR
about: Без лиц, только руки, звук и красивые ингредиенты.
prompt: Overhead and close-up shots, hands only: preparing [DISH] step by step — chopping [INGREDIENT], cracking an egg, butter melting in a pan, final plating. Natural window light, wooden board, minimal props. Sound: amplified ASMR — chopping, sizzling, pouring. No music, no faces.

title: Цепная реакция
about: Домино, шарики, механизмы — эффект Голдберга.
prompt: A long tracking shot following a chain reaction: dominoes fall into a marble run, the marble hits a lever that tips a cup, which rings a tiny bell, ending with [FINAL EVENT, e.g. a flag rising with the text "[TEXT]"]. Bright playroom set, crisp focus, smooth camera follow. Sound: clicks, rolls and a final ding.

title: Эстетичный рум-тур
about: Плавный проезд по комнате мечты.
prompt: Smooth gimbal walk-through of a [STYLE: Japandi / cottagecore / Y2K] [ROOM TYPE] at golden hour: linen curtains moving, plants, a record player spinning, sunlight patterns on the wall. Slow, dreamy, film-like colour. Sound: soft lo-fi ambience.

title: Эволюция через века
about: Предмет/место морфит через эпохи.
prompt: Continuous morph, static camera: [OBJECT / PLACE] evolves through time — [ERA 1] → [ERA 2] → [ERA 3] → [ERA 4] → futuristic version. Each stage ~2 s, transformations flow seamlessly (materials, colours and shapes change). A year counter in the corner. Photorealistic, consistent framing.

title: А что, если…
about: Фантазийный сценарий: «Что, если бы Луна была ближе».
prompt: "What if [SCENARIO]?" — a photorealistic shot of [EVERYDAY PLACE] where [CONSEQUENCE] has happened: people stop and stare, the camera slowly tilts up to reveal [BIG VISUAL]. Natural daylight, documentary realism, awe-inspiring scale. Sound: city ambience fading into a deep hum.

title: Вид от первого лица
about: Камера — глаза героя: руки в кадре, действие.
prompt: First-person POV, GoPro-like wide lens: your hands [ACTION: grab a ladder / open a mysterious door / pet a dragon] in [PLACE]. Head-bob motion, natural breathing rhythm, immersive. [LIGHTING]. Sound: footsteps, breathing, [AMBIENT].

title: Уличное интервью
about: Ведущий с микрофоном задаёт вопрос прохожему.
prompt: Street interview style, vertical. A host holds a microphone toward a fictional passer-by ([DESCRIPTION]) on a busy [CITY] street and asks: "[QUESTION]". The passer-by answers with a funny, unexpected reply: "[ANSWER]". Handheld, natural light, background crowd, burned-in captions.

title: Преображение (глоу-ап)
about: Комната/вещь/персонаж: «было → стало» одним махом.
prompt: Before/after transformation in one move: start on a [BEFORE: messy room / rusty bike / plain sketch]; a hand swipes across the lens and the scene becomes [AFTER: the redesigned version]. Same camera position and framing in both halves. Satisfying, bright, crisp.

title: Пародия на документалку
about: Голос «как у натуралиста» про офис/кота/себя.
prompt: Wildlife documentary style, telephoto lens with slight shake, as if filmed from hiding. Subject: [EVERYDAY SUBJECT: an office worker at the coffee machine / a toddler / a cat]. Calm British-style narrator (original voice, not a real person): "[NARRATION LINE]". The subject does [ACTION] at the funniest moment. Natural light, documentary grade.

title: Гиперлапс путешествия
about: Быстрый проезд через город/страну за секунды.
prompt: Hyperlapse, moving forward fast: a journey from [START] to [END] — streets, landmarks (generic, not real brands), changing weather and day to night, compressed into 10 seconds with smooth stabilised motion and occasional speed ramps. Vibrant, energetic. Sound: rising rhythmic beat.

title: Маскот реагирует на тренд
about: Твой фирменный герой повторяет популярный жест/танец.
prompt: [CHARACTER LINE] performs [TREND ACTION, described in your own words: a simple dance / reaction / gesture] in front of [BACKGROUND], hitting the moves on the beat, ending with a wink to camera. Bright, clean lighting, full-body shot, character design kept exactly consistent. Sound: upbeat original track.
